events.title: Argosy crew observes lights near Clarence River mouth during radar activity
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** SAFE Argosy crew flying Woodbourne–Christchurch, with the captain in radio contact with Wellington Radar. **Sighting:** On the night of 20/21 Dec 1978 the first aircraft saw lights low over the Clarence River mouth area; later at 0406 the second aircraft again checked the same vicinity because radar returns were being picked up. **Object:** The lights were seen seaward, appeared possibly rectangular in pattern, and one seemed to have a beam-like appearance rather than a point source. **Tactics:** The lights appeared to move out or disappear as the aircraft approached; the captain estimated the source may have been about 1,000 ft above the water, though this was uncertain. **Note:** The report suggests helicopters or other mundane causes were possible, but no local reports of aircraft activity were confirmed.
events.report_summary_zh: **证人：** SAFE Argosy 航班机组，包含机长，并与惠灵顿雷达联络。**目击：** 1978年12月20/21日夜间，第一架飞机在 Clarence River 河口一带看到低空灯光；随后在凌晨0406，第二架飞机因该区域出现雷达回波再次前往查看。**物体：** 灯光位于海上方向，似乎呈矩形排列，其中一团光看起来像有光束而非单一点光源。**行为：** 当飞机接近时，灯光似乎移出视野或消失；机长估计光源可能在水面上方约1000英尺，但并不确定。**注：** 报告认为也可能是直升机或其他平常原因，但当地并未证实有相关航空活动报告。

events.title: Three lights seen near Woodbourne by RNZAF duty officers
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** The Orderly Officer and Duty Air Traffic Controller at RNZAF Base Woodbourne.  **Sighting:** At 2350 on 20/21 Dec 1978, they saw what appeared to be three lights, roughly 3–4 miles from Woodbourne.  **Object:** The lights were first thought to be from a Bristol Freighter; no aircraft could be heard and the lights were checked through binoculars. The middle light looked like a white beam pointing northward.  **Tactics:** The lights seemed to move upward and around; as no aircraft was heard and no closer approach occurred, the crew concluded it was an unusual light display rather than a normal aircraft.  **Note:** The page is part of a larger restricted report and also mentions other radar observations, but this item is the concrete sighting on the page.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** RNZAF Woodbourne 基地的值班军官和值班空中交通管制员。  **目击经过：** 1978年12月20/21日23:50，他们看到大约在伍德伯恩外3至4英里处有三盏灯。  **物体：** 起初以为是布里斯托尔货机，但现场没有听到任何飞机声音；他们还用双筒望远镜查看。中间那盏灯看起来像一束朝北的白色光束。  **行为：** 灯光似乎向上并绕行移动；由于没有听到飞机声，也没有更接近，因此他们认为这不是普通飞机，而是异常灯光现象。  **备注：** 这一页属于一份更大的机密报告；页面上还有其他雷达观测内容，但此条是该页中具体的目击事件。

events.title: Woodbourne light formation observed toward Cape Campbell
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Woodbourne observer, plus the Duty Air Traffic Controller observing from the control tower balcony. **Sighting:** Over about 50 minutes, the lights were watched on 20/21 December 1978. The bearing from Woodbourne was about 080° (toward Cape Campbell). **Object:** Three lights were described: one bright orange light and two less intense white lights. The bright light stayed stationary while the other two seemed to move north; a shaft of light periodically appeared to “beam down” from the white lights at about 40° in a northerly direction. **Tactics:** The lights sometimes appeared to “rush forward” but generally drifted or remained fixed. Binoculars showed no obvious enlargement effect. **Note:** The reporting officer considered a natural/unusual atmospheric explanation possible and thought the visual and radar observations were probably related, but not certainly connected.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Woodbourne 的一名观察者，以及在控制塔阳台上观察的值班空中交通管制员。**目击：** 1978年12月20/21日，灯光被持续观察了约50分钟。从 Woodbourne 看去方位约为080°（朝向 Cape Campbell）。**物体：** 目击者描述了三盏灯：一盏明亮的橙色灯和两盏较弱的白灯。明亮的橙灯似乎静止不动，而另外两盏看起来向北移动；白灯还会不时出现一束“向下照射”的光，方向大约为向北40°。**行为：** 这些灯有时看起来会“猛地向前冲”，但总体上只是漂移或保持静止。用双筒望远镜观察时，灯光并未表现出明显放大效果。**备注：** 报告官认为可能存在自然/异常的大气解释，并认为目视与雷达观测很可能相关，但不能确定一定有关联。

events.title: Aircraft crew observations and lights along NZ flight route
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: New Zealand, air route between Auckland and Christchurch
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Aircraft crew observed the activity during a flight over New Zealand. **Sighting:** The page is a hand-drawn route sketch titled “OBSERVATIONS 30/31 DEC 78,” mapping a sequence of sightings and radar returns along a north–south flight path. **Object:** Multiple light formations are marked at different points; notes indicate lights seen visually, radar returns, and at least one target tracked while the aircraft moved between locations. **Tactics:** The sketch suggests the object(s) changed position relative to the aircraft and were observed at several times over the route. **Note:** This is a diagram/annex page, but it clearly documents a concrete sighting event rather than editorial material.
events.report_summary_zh: **证人：** 飞机机组人员在新西兰上空飞行时观察到该活动。 **目击：** 这页是一张手绘航线示意图，标题为“OBSERVATIONS 30/31 DEC 78”，记录了沿南北航线在多个位置出现的目击与雷达回波。 **物体：** 图中标注了多个光点/光群；备注说明既有目视光点，也有雷达回波，并且飞机在不同地点附近持续跟踪到至少一个目标。 **轨迹：** 示意图表明这些物体相对于飞机不断变化位置，并在航线上多个时间点被观察到。 **注：** 这是一页附图/附件，但它明确记录了一个具体的目击事件，而不是编辑性内容。

events.title: Kaikoura lights observation map, 20/21 Dec 1978
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** RNZAF/radar personnel and aircrew associated with the 20/21 Dec 1978 observations. **Sighting:** This page is a hand-drawn route/map diagram summarizing the event, with observation times and plotted tracks over the Kaikoura–Marlborough area. **Object:** The notes mark repeated radar returns and lights observed, including a return tracked by radar and apparent movement westward, plus an object seen near the Clarence/Woodbourne area. **Tactics:** The diagram shows successive positions, bearings, and time stamps (e.g. 2359, 0328, 0400) indicating multiple observations across the night. **Note:** This is a supporting chart page rather than a narrative report, but it clearly documents a specific UFO/UAP incident on 20/21 Dec 1978.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 与1978年12月20/21日观察有关的新西兰皇家空军/雷达人员与机组。**目击：** 本页是一张手绘路线/地图示意图，概述了这起事件，并标注了观测时间以及在凯库拉—马尔堡地区上空的轨迹。**物体：** 备注显示多次雷达回波和目视灯光，包括一个被雷达追踪、似乎向西移动的回波，以及在克拉伦斯/伍德伯恩附近看到的目标。**战术：** 图中标出了连续的位置、方位和时间戳（如2359、0328、0400），表明整夜有多次观测。**注：** 这是一页辅助性图表而非叙述报告，但它清楚记录了1978年12月20/21日的一起具体UFO/UAP事件。

events.title: Picton witness reports low flying round cloud over Queen Charlotte Sound
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A civilian observer in Picton wrote to Defence reporting what he saw from a third-floor window in the Town House. **Sighting:** On 9 Dec 1978, shortly after 8 p.m., he looked out over Queen Charlotte Sound and saw a strange object low in the sky, several miles down the sound. **Object:** It looked like a round cloud in two shades of grey, light on top and darker underneath, roughly 30 ft across and about 12 ft deep, with no lights visible. **Tactics:** He said it was first south of Mt. McMahon, then moved for 7–8 seconds, swooping side to side as it came low through the hills, crossing Kenepuru Sound and passing over Chaumparupari Bay and Black Rock, Kumutoto. **Note:** The report compares the object’s size to nearby boats and identifies the route using a Lands & Survey map of Marlborough Sounds.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一位来自皮克顿（Picton）的平民观察者写信给国防部门，称自己从镇屋（Town House）三楼窗户看到了这一现象。**目击：** 1978年12月9日晚上约8点后，他望向夏洛特女王湾（Queen Charlotte Sound），看到一个奇异物体低悬在天空中，位置在海湾数英里外。**物体：** 它看起来像一团分成两种灰色的圆形云状物，上部较亮、下部较暗，直径约30英尺、深约12英尺，没有任何灯光。**机动：** 他称该物体最初位于麦克马洪山（Mt. McMahon）以南，随后在7到8秒内以左右摆动、掠过山丘的方式前进，穿过肯佩鲁湾（Kenepuru Sound），再越过 Chaumparupari Bay 和 Kumutoto 的 Black Rock。**备注：** 这份报告用马尔堡海湾（Marlborough Sounds）的 Lands & Survey 地图来判断其路径，并与附近船只大小作比较。

events.title: Bright light over Hikurangi
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A compiled NZDF/UFO archive table records a sighting report from Hikurangi, Northland. **Sighting:** On 4 Jan 1974 at about 0950, a bright light was seen heading across the sky. **Object:** Described only as a bright light; the table lists a probable conventional explanation as a satellite. **Tactics:** No maneuvering details are given beyond moving across the sky. **Note:** The page is a tabulated summary of multiple reports, but this entry is a concrete dated-and-located sighting.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 这页NZDF/UFO档案汇总表记录了一起来自北地Hikurangi的目击报告。**目击：** 1974年1月4日约09:50，一道明亮的光被看到横穿天空。**物体：** 仅描述为一道明亮的光；表中给出的可能常规解释是卫星。**动作：** 除了在天空中移动外，没有更多机动细节。**注：** 这一页是多条报告的表格汇总，但这一条本身是具体、带日期和地点的目击事件。

events.title: Brooklyn, Wellington UFO seen hovering then disappearing into cloud
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Three adults, including the letter writer, were at a friend's house in Brooklyn, Wellington. **Sighting:** Around 5 p.m. on 23 April 1976 they observed an unidentified object in the sky. **Object:** It was seen hovering and was viewed clearly enough that the writer could not say whether it was a conventional aircraft, but it had the appearance of a UFO. **Tactics:** The object was initially visible to the north, then disappeared into a cloud to the south. **Note:** The writer says they had an excellent, unobstructed view of the object before it vanished.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 共有三名成年人，包括写信人本人，在惠灵顿布鲁克林一位朋友家中。**目击经过：** 1976年4月23日约下午5点，他们在天空中看到一个不明物体。**物体：** 该物体曾悬停；写信人看得很清楚，但无法判断是否为普通飞机，只能确认其呈现出UFO的外观。**机动/轨迹：** 物体先在北方可见，随后向南并消失在云中。**备注：** 写信人称当时视野极佳、无遮挡，在物体消失前曾有清楚观察。

events.title: Napier daytime UFO seen over houses and hills
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** An unnamed caller reported the sighting by telephone to police, and the note was signed by Sgt. Thomas. **Sighting:** On Monday 13 Nov 1972 at about 11:30 am in Napier, the witness said he saw a UFO while driving on High Street. **Object:** He described it as larger and thicker than the house, with the appearance of two full moons and lights all around it, estimating it at about 30–40 feet across. **Tactics:** The object was stationary for about 20 seconds, then turned on its side and changed appearance to look flat. **Note:** The report says the object was seen over houses near the hills to the west of the valley, with its height estimated at about the height of those hills.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一名未具名来电者向警方报案，记录由 Thomas 警佐签署。**目击：** 1972年11月13日星期一上午约11:30，在纳皮尔（Napier），目击者称自己在 High Street 驾车时看到一架不明飞行物。**物体：** 他描述该物体比房屋更大、更厚，外观像“两轮满月”，周围有灯光，估计直径约30–40英尺。**行为：** 该物体静止约20秒，随后转向侧面，并变成看起来像扁平的形状。**备注：** 报告称它出现在房屋上方、靠近山谷西侧山丘的位置，其高度估计与那些山丘相当。

events.title: Glowing object seen over Lower Hutt
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mrs Stone, her husband, and two friends in Lower Hutt. **Sighting:** On the evening of 8 Nov 1972, after a basketball night, they were standing in a driveway at Wainuiomata Road when Mrs Stone pointed out an object in the sky. **Object:** A glowing light, apparently oval-shaped and later seen as four oval lights in a row; it seemed to have darker sections and lights along the edges. **Tactics:** The object moved very fast, then looped and banked on its side, drifting east toward the hills of Naenae and Stokes Valley; it was visible for at least two minutes and made no sound. **Note:** The witness said it was unlike any aeroplane she had seen and that it gave no light on the garden or cast a shadow.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 1972年11月8日晚上，石太太（Mrs Stone）、她的丈夫以及两名朋友在下哈特（Lower Hutt）。**目击：** 在威努伊奥马塔路（Wainuiomata Road）的一处车道上，他们在打完篮球聚会后站着聊天时，石太太指向天空中的一个物体。**物体：** 一个发光的物体，起初像椭圆形光体，后来看起来像一排四个椭圆光点；其下部和边缘似乎有较暗的部分和灯光。**动作：** 该物体移动极快，随后侧身盘旋并倾斜飞行，向东移向奈纳伊（Naenae）和斯托克斯谷（Stokes Valley）山丘；至少可见两分钟，且没有声音。**注：** 目击者称它与她见过的任何飞机都不同，而且没有照亮院子，也没有投下影子。

events.title: White circular object near Kaiti Hill seen from Gisborne Airport
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** B.K. Waugh, met observer on duty at Gisborne Airport, reported the event in a letter dated 5 Apr 1972. **Sighting:** On Wednesday night 29 Mar 1972, after a balloon launch, he saw a white circular object in the sky near Kaiti Hill. He watched it for about five minutes through a theodolite. **Object:** The object emitted a red glow, showed no clear signalling features, then moved out to sea and vanished into thin air; he reported no noise. **Tactics:** Cloud cover was 7/8 with a small break to the north, wind from NW, and no stars visible; he noted azimuth/elevation readings while tracking it. **Note:** Waugh added that as a former pilot he had not seen anything similar before and that the object was later tracked by many radar stations in the UK in a separate 1954 incident he mentioned for comparison.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 吉斯本机场值勤的气象观测员 B.K. Waugh（也是一名前飞行员）在一封 1972 年 4 月 5 日的信中报告了这次事件。**目击：** 1972 年 3 月 29 日星期三夜晚，在一次气球放飞之后，他在 Kaiti Hill 附近的天空中看见一个白色圆形物体，并用经纬仪观察了约五分钟。**物体：** 该物体发出红色光芒，没有明显信号特征，随后向海面移动并消失，他称没有听到任何声音。**轨迹：** 当时云量约为 7/8，北方有一小片云隙，风向为西北，天空无可见星体；他记录了方位角和仰角数据进行追踪。**备注：** Waugh 说作为一名前飞行员，他此前从未见过类似现象；信中还提到他把这次目击与英国 1954 年另一宗被多部雷达追踪的事件作对比。

events.title: Fishing vessel Chinook sees color-changing light in Preservation Inlet
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** The fishing vessel *Chinook* was reported by Christchurch police via Lt. Comm. K. Knight, RNZ Navy, and later checked by Invercargill Police with the skipper and crew.

**Sighting:** On 4 June 1971 at about 0710 hours, the crew saw a UFO while the vessel was between Gulchers Point and Coal Island, Preservation Inlet.

**Object:** It was described as a light/object at about 200–300 feet, 10–12 times brighter than a star, and changing colour between white, orange, and red.

**Tactics:** The object was stationary; no further details could be established after interviews with the skipper and crew.

**Note:** This is a police-reported sighting summary forwarded to the Ministry of Defence.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 渔船 *Chinook* 的船长和船员；基督城警方先通过海军中尉 K. Knight 得知此事，随后因弗卡吉尔警方又采访了船长和船员。

**目击情况：** 1971年6月4日约0710时，船只在 Preservation Inlet 的 Gulchers Point 与 Coal Island 之间航行时，看见一不明飞行物。

**物体：** 据称该光点/物体高度约200–300英尺，亮度比星星强10–12倍，并在白色、橙色和红色之间变化。

**行动：** 该物体保持静止；在对船长和船员的采访后，未能获得更多细节。

**备注：** 这是一份转呈国防部的警方目击摘要。

events.title: Fishing boat skipper sees bright object over Preservation Inlet
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: Preservation Inlet, near Goulches Head and Coal Island, Southland, NZ
events.report_summary: **Witness:** The skipper of the fishing boat *Chinook* and his only crew member were steaming south toward Bluff. **Sighting:** At about 6:45 am on Friday 4 June 1971, near the mouth of Preservation Inlet between Goulches Head and Coal Island, they saw an object rise quickly to about a 40° angle and remain there for roughly half an hour. **Object:** It was first like a parachute distress flare with an orange tail, then the orange changed to red and back again before the colours disappeared, leaving an extremely bright white light. The witnesses estimated it was at least ten times larger than the brightest star. **Tactics:** The skipper first called Awarua Radio, then kept contact for about an hour and the station later contacted Christchurch. **Note:** The object stayed apparently stationary for about 30 minutes and then gradually gained more height.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 渔船 *Chinook* 的船长和他唯一的船员当时正驾船向南前往布拉夫。**目击：** 1971年6月4日星期五早上约6:45，在南兰区 Preservation Inlet 入口附近、Goulches Head 与 Coal Island 之间，他们看到一个物体迅速升到约40°的仰角，并在那里停留了大约半小时。**物体：** 起初看起来像带橙色尾焰的降落伞求救信号弹；随后橙色变成红色，又反复变化，之后颜色消失，只剩下极亮的白光。目击者估计它至少比天空中最亮的恒星大十倍。**行动：** 船长先呼叫 Awarua Radio，随后约一个小时持续联系；无线电台之后又联系了 Christchurch。**注：** 该物体看似静止约30分钟，之后又逐渐升高。

events.title: Christchurch radar tracks mystery object
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Christchurch meteorological radar personnel, reporting an object seen on radar. **Sighting:** The article says Christchurch radar was tracking a target that appeared on the scope and was followed as it moved, eventually being reported from around Hokitika and then near Christchurch. **Object:** Described as a "mystery object" / radar target, with no conventional aircraft identity established in the clipping. **Tactics:** The target reportedly climbed at very high speed, with the radar officer saying the tracking was maintained as long as possible before the return weakened and disappeared. **Note:** This is a press clipping summarizing a radar-only UFO/UAP incident in the South Island; the clipping attributes the account to a report obtained by *Truth*.
events.report_summary_zh: **见证人：** 基督城气象雷达人员，报告雷达上出现并被追踪到一个目标。**目击：** 文章称基督城雷达正在追踪一个目标，该目标在显示屏上出现并被跟踪移动，文中还提到它来自霍基蒂卡方向，并在接近基督城附近被继续观察。**物体：** 被描述为“神秘物体”/雷达目标，剪报中未能确认其为常规飞机。**行为：** 据称该目标以极高速度爬升，雷达员表示在回波减弱并消失前尽可能持续跟踪。**注：** 这是一则报纸剪报，概述了南岛一次仅由雷达记录的 UFO/UAP 事件；剪报称内容来自《Truth》获得的一份报告。

events.title: Matawai farmer reports saucer-shaped object and loud hiss
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Matawai farmer in the Gisborne area reported the incident, with the account passed through Central Police Ops and noted by local police. **Sighting:** During the morning of 31 May 1971, the witness heard a loud hissing noise that scattered his four dogs, then saw a saucer-shaped object. **Object:** The object was described as about 5 feet in diameter. **Tactics:** The farmer blacked out; on recovering, he found damaged fence posts and wire fence line. **Note:** Local police reportedly confirmed the damage, and another civil aviation witness considered the weather fine, cloudy only, with no sign of electrical storm or gibberne disturbance.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 1971年5月31日，吉斯伯恩地区 Matawai 一名农夫报告了这起事件，内容经由中央警务行动室转达，并被当地警方记录。**目击经过：** 当天上午，目击者听到一阵尖锐的嘶嘶声，把他的四只狗都惊散了，随后看见一个碟状物体。**物体：** 据称该物体直径约 5 英尺。**行为：** 农夫随后昏厥；恢复意识后，他发现围栏木桩和铁丝篱笆线受损。**备注：** 当地警方据称证实了这些损坏，另有一名民航方面目击者认为天气晴好、仅有云层，没有电暴迹象或地面扰动。

events.title: Wellington airport radar and aircrew report slow-moving UFO
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Crew of a Bristol freighter operating for Straits Air Freight Express, with Wellington airport terminal radar also involved.

**Sighting:** On 4 September 1969, the pilots first saw an unidentified object at about 7:30 p.m., with a second observation at about 9:00 p.m. near Wellington.

**Object:** Described as a slow-moving UFO; the letter asks whether RNZAF had identified it as a plane or balloon, or whether it remained unidentified.

**Tactics:** The object was visually tracked by the aircrew and reportedly confirmed by airport radar.

**Note:** This page is a later inquiry letter dated 6 March 1970, but it refers to a specific earlier sighting event in Wellington.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一架布里斯托尔货机机组（Straits Air Freight Express），以及惠灵顿机场终端雷达。

**目击：** 1969年9月4日，飞行员约在晚上7:30首次看到一个不明物体，约晚上9:00在惠灵顿附近又有一次观察。

**物体：** 被描述为缓慢移动的UFO；来信询问RNZAF是否已将其识别为飞机或气球，抑或仍属不明。

**战术：** 该物体被机组以肉眼追踪，据称也被机场雷达证实。

**备注：** 这页是1970年3月6日的后续询问信件，但内容涉及一个明确的1969年惠灵顿目击事件。

events.title: Blenheim saucer-shaped object with dome and figures
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Mrs. Frederick Moreland of Blenheim, as described in a letter from Herbert S. Taylor to RNZAF.

**Sighting:** On 13 July 1959 she reportedly observed a UFO at close range, said to be about 50 yards away.

**Object:** A saucer-shaped craft with a transparent dome; two human-like figures were visible inside the dome.

**Tactics:** No maneuvering details are given on this page beyond the close observation and clear outline.

**Note:** This page is a later inquiry letter asking RNZAF for the official evaluation of the incident, not the original report itself, but it still preserves the date, location, witness, and observed features of the sighting.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 这页引述了布伦海姆的 Mrs. Frederick Moreland 的目击情况，内容出自 Herbert S. Taylor 致新西兰空军（RNZAF）的信件。

**目击经过：** 据称她在 1959 年 7 月 13 日看到一个 UFO，距离约 50 码，属于近距离观察。

**物体：** 一个圆盘状飞行物，带有透明穹顶；据称在穹顶内可以看见两个类人形身影。

**动作：** 这页没有提供更多机动细节，只说明该物体轮廓清晰、可近距离辨认。

**备注：** 这是一封后来向 RNZAF 询问该事件官方结论的信件，不是原始报告，但页面仍保留了日期、地点、目击者和所见特征，因此可视为具体的 UFO 目击事件。

events.title: Havelock North schoolchildren reported a saucer-like object
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Havelock North schoolchildren, as described in a newspaper clipping attached to the page. **Sighting:** The clipping says the children saw a saucer-like object “yesterday,” and the surrounding article discusses local UFO sightings around the Hastings-Napier area. **Object:** Described only as a “saucer-like object”; no size, color, motion, or duration is given on this page. **Tactics:** None reported. **Note:** The rest of the page is a questionnaire/letter about UFOs, but the clipping itself refers to a concrete sighting event.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 霍克斯湾哈韦洛克北（Havelock North）的学童，如页面所附报纸剪报所述。**目击：** 剪报称这些孩子在“昨天”看到了一个类似飞碟的物体，相关文章还提到黑斯廷斯—纳皮尔一带的当地 UFO 目击。**物体：** 仅描述为“像飞碟的物体”；页面未提供大小、颜色、移动方式或持续时间。**行为：** 未报告任何规避或互动行为。**注：** 页面其余部分是关于 UFO 的问卷/信件，但剪报本身指向一个具体的目击事件。

events.title: Masterton woman reports yellow-orange triangular object
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Masterton woman telephoned an RNZAF officer to report what she had seen. **Sighting:** On 11 December 1967 at about 0030 hours, in clear still night conditions over Masterton, she observed an object moving from west to east on a steady, well-defined course. **Object:** She described it as an enclosed triangle, yellow-orange inside with oscillating red flames around the outside edge; it made a humming noise, appeared about 1000 ft long, and she said it did not look like a meteor but more like a missile. **Note:** The report was forwarded for attention; the witness was said to be very insistent about knowing what action would be taken.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一位来自马斯特顿的女性致电新西兰皇家空军，报告她所看到的现象。**目击：** 1967年12月11日约0030时，在晴朗平静的夜空中，她在马斯特顿上空看到一个物体按稳定、清晰的路线自西向东移动。**物体：** 她描述该物体为一个封闭的三角形，内部呈黄橙色，外缘有摆动的红色火焰；它发出嗡嗡声，估计约1000英尺长，她说它不像流星，更像导弹。**备注：** 该报告已转交处理；据称该目击者非常坚持要知道会采取什么行动。

events.title: Napier family reports bright light moving and hovering over sky
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Napier resident wrote to the Air Department describing an unusual sighting seen with four family members. **Sighting:** On 3 January 1965 at about 10:35 p.m., under clear skies and excellent visibility, they watched a light in the sky for 6–8 minutes. **Object:** The light appeared to descend from near the Southern Cross, turn northeast at a leisurely pace, level off, stop about three times, then accelerate upward from a straight-and-level path, losing intensity as it climbed. It was compared to a first-magnitude star when level, and there was no noise. **Tactics:** The witness suggested it may have been something with controlled motion rather than a meteor; it hovered briefly before being “withdrawn from sale” was mentioned jokingly as no explanation fit. **Note:** The letter is dated 8 February 1965, but the sighting itself occurred on 3 January 1965.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一位纳皮尔居民致信航空部门，报告自己和四名家人共同目击到一次异常现象。**目击经过：** 1965年1月3日晚上约10:35，在天空晴朗、能见度极佳的条件下，他们观察到一个天空中的亮点持续了约6到8分钟。**物体：** 该亮点似乎从南十字星附近下降，以相当悠闲的速度向东北方向移动，随后拉平，并大约停了三次，然后从直线平飞状态开始迅速上升，升高时亮度逐渐减弱。它在平飞时的亮度被比作一等星，而且没有任何声音。**动作方式：** 目击者认为这不像流星，更像是某种受控飞行物；它曾短暂停留悬停。**备注：** 这封信的日期是1965年2月8日，但真正的目击发生在1965年1月3日。

events.title: Lower Hutt daylight object seen by two witnesses
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Lower Hutt resident and their sister. **Sighting:** They reported seeing an object on 28 June 1964. **Object:** The page does not describe the object’s shape, colour, or movement in detail; it only notes the sighting was investigated. **Tactics:** RNZAF reviewed air activity and concluded there was no Canberra aircraft flying in the area at the time, aside from a training aircraft operating between Ohakea and Whetuapai. **Note:** This is a reply letter summarizing an investigation rather than the original report, but it still refers to a concrete sighting event.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 惠灵顿下哈特（Lower Hutt）的一位居民及其姐妹。**目击：** 他们报告称在 1964 年 6 月 28 日看到一个物体。**物体：** 该页没有详细描述物体的形状、颜色或运动方式，只说明对此次目击进行了调查。**调查结论：** RNZAF 核查了当时的空中活动，认为该区域并没有 Canberra 轰炸机飞行；当天唯一的 Canberra 飞机是往返 Ohakea 与 Whetuapai 之间的训练飞行。**备注：** 这是一封调查回复信，而不是最初的目击报告，但它仍然指向一个具体的目击事件。

events.title: Unidentified object/plane seen over Hamilton
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A civilian writer says he saw the event in Hamilton on 28 June 1964, with his sister present during part of the outing.  **Sighting:** In the late afternoon, as rain cleared and clouds began to break, he noticed something in the sky and later walked up to Cathedral Hill to get a better look.  **Object:** He refers to it as a “plane,” but says no one could tell him what it was; the wording suggests uncertainty about whether it was an aircraft or something else unusual.  **Tactics:** He considered taking a camera in case anything interesting appeared, but no photographs were taken.  **Note:** The letter is a civilian inquiry/report asking for an explanation of what was seen rather than a formal official observation.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一名平民写信称，他于1964年6月28日在汉密尔顿目睹了该事件，期间其妹妹也在场。  **目击：** 傍晚时分，雨势减弱、云层开始散开时，他注意到天空中有一个东西；随后他还与妹妹一起步行到 Cathedral Hill 以便看得更清楚。  **物体：** 他把它称作“一架飞机”，但又说没人能告诉他那到底是什么；措辞显示他并不确定那是否真是一架普通飞机，还是别的异常物体。  **行动：** 他曾考虑带上相机，以防出现有趣的景象，但最终没有拍到照片。  **注：** 这是一封平民询问/报告信，内容更像是在寻求解释，而不是正式的官方观测记录。

events.title: Unidentified object over Funafuti observed by radar and balloon flights
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** The memo is from the Officer-in-Charge, Meteorological Office, Funafuti, responding to reports from local observers and radar readings. **Sighting:** On the night of 5 May 1961, an unidentified object was reported passing over Funafuti. A visual search was made at about the 18th minute when the range reached 2,100 yards, but nothing was seen despite a fairly bright moon. **Object:** The writer notes the signal was almost as steady and stronger than that obtained from the permanent echo range (1,200 yards), suggesting it was not a trivial return. **Tactics:** The report mentions simultaneous radar observations and two balloon flights that were observed that night. **Note:** Nadi had suggested migratory birds, but this was considered doubtful by the writer, who also says the two Ellice Island observers were not keen on walking home in the dark.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 这份备忘录由富纳富提气象站负责人撰写，依据当地观察员的报告和雷达读数。**目击：** 1961年5月5日晚，据称有一个不明物体从富纳富提上空经过。当天在距离达到2100码时进行了目视搜索，但尽管月光较亮，仍未看到任何东西。**物体：** 报告指出，该信号几乎同样稳定，且比永久回波范围（1200码）得到的信号更强，说明它不像是普通杂波。**战术：** 文中提到当晚有雷达观测和两次气球飞行，并且都被观察到。**注：** 纳迪方面曾推测可能是候鸟，但撰写人认为这种解释值得怀疑，同时还提到两位埃利斯群岛观察员不太愿意在天黑后步行回家。

events.title: Radar and visual search after unidentified object over Paraparaumu
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Officer-in-Charge, Meteorological Office, Paraparaumu, with radar staff and two balloon-flight observers. **Sighting:** The memo asks for theories about an unidentified object that passed over Paraparaumu on the night of 28 May 1961, using radar readings and the observation of two balloon flights that night. **Object:** A fast-moving unidentified target produced a signal almost as steady and stronger than the station’s normal echo at 1200 yards. **Tactics:** A visual search was carried out at 6:18 pm when range was 2100 yards, but nothing was seen despite fairly bright moonlight. **Note:** The writer suggests migrating birds as a possible explanation, though this is described as doubtful.
events.report_summary_zh: **见证人：** 帕拉帕拉乌穆（Paraparaumu）气象办公室负责人，以及雷达人员和两名气球飞行观察员。**目击：** 这封备忘录询问对 1961 年 5 月 28 日夜间掠过帕拉帕拉乌穆的一不明物体的解释，并提到当晚的雷达读数和两次气球飞行观察。**物体：** 一个快速移动的不明目标，其雷达信号几乎稳定，且强度超过本站平时 1200 码回波。**行动：** 在下午 6:18、距离 2100 码时进行了目视搜索；尽管月光较亮，仍未看到任何东西。**备注：** 作者提出可能是候鸟，但也认为这一解释存疑。

events.title: Vapour trail reported over Hawke's Bay
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Dannevirke correspondent wrote to the Air Secretary about observations they had made. **Sighting:** The letters referred to a sighting of a "vapour trail" over Hawke's Bay, reported in November 1960. **Object:** The observed phenomenon is described only as a vapour trail; the letter says no RNZAF jets were operating in the area at the time and the stated speeds were beyond normal aircraft capabilities. **Tactics:** No evasive or manoeuvring behavior is described. **Note:** This page is a response letter dated 25 January 1961; it confirms the observations were studied but offers no explanation.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一位来自丹尼维克的来信者就其所做的观察写信给空军秘书。**目击：** 信中提到 1960 年 11 月在霍克斯湾上空看到一条“蒸气尾迹”。**物体：** 所见现象仅被描述为蒸气尾迹；信中称当时该地区没有 RNZAF 喷气机活动，且所述速度超过了普通飞机能力。**战术：** 未描述任何规避或机动行为。**注：** 本页是 1961 年 1 月 25 日的回复信，确认已对观察进行研究，但未给出解释。

events.title: Daytime vapour-trail-like object seen over Hawke's Bay
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A civilian correspondent writing from Hawke's Bay. He says he pointed the object out first to his wife and then to a neighbour. **Sighting:** Around 12:30 pm, he noticed a bright, vapour-trail-like object moving across the sky from west toward east over Hawke's Bay. It climbed to nearly overhead and then rapidly moved away toward the eastern horizon. **Object:** Described as a bright central point or head with a long trail, at times appearing like a jet/vapour trail, but with no visible aircraft body. **Tactics:** The object traversed the sky very quickly, taking only about 2–3 minutes to cross the visible area. **Note:** The witness mentions the object looked unlike anything he had seen before and that it was visible high enough that no plane could be discerned, only the trail and bright point.
events.report_summary_zh: **Witness:** 一位来自霍克斯湾的平民通信者。他说自己先把该物体指给妻子看，随后又给邻居看。**Sighting:** 大约中午 12:30，他注意到天空中有一个带有类似尾迹的明亮物体，从西向东穿过霍克斯湾上空。它升至接近头顶后，又迅速朝东边地平线方向离去。**Object:** 描述为一个明亮的中心点或“头部”，拖着很长的尾迹；看起来有点像喷气机的尾迹，但看不见飞机机身。**Tactics:** 该物体移动非常快，穿越可见天空只用了约 2–3 分钟。**Note:** 目击者说这东西与他以往见过的都不同，而且高度很高，只能看到尾迹和亮点，看不出飞机。

events.title: Family report of a star-like oval object over Takaka
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A man writing from Takaka, Nelson, says he watched the object with his wife and two children. **Sighting:** At about 9:40 pm they saw a “star” swinging in the air; it remained visible until about 10:30 pm, when it sailed away in a direct line and out of sight. **Object:** Through field glasses it appeared as a clear oval form; the planes of the ellipse, its strength of light, and colour changed often. **Tactics:** The observer says it moved in a very unusual manner and that it could come close, possibly anywhere from three miles away to infinity. **Note:** He states he had owned a boat for ten years on Waiheke Island and was familiar with navigation lights, but still found the object strange.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一名来自尼尔森塔卡卡（Takaka）的男子称，他和妻子及两个孩子一起观看了该物体。**目击经过：** 大约晚上9:40，他们看到天空中有一颗“星星”在摆动；它一直可见到约10:30，随后沿直线离开并消失。**物体：** 用望远镜观察时，它呈清晰的椭圆形；椭圆的方向、光亮强度和颜色经常变化。**行为：** 目击者说它的移动方式非常不寻常，而且似乎会靠得很近，距离可能从三英里到无限远。**备注：** 他表示自己在怀赫科岛（Waiheke Island）拥有船只已十年，熟悉航标灯，但仍认为该物体很奇怪。

events.title: Large white light with tail seen from aircraft near 24S 177E
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Crew of Pan American aircraft C012.

**Sighting:** At 1210Z on 28 Sep 1958, while flying near 24°S 177°E at flight level 8500, the crew reported a large white light ahead of the aircraft.

**Object:** The light was heading southwest and descending toward the earth’s surface at an estimated 60-degree angle. It had a long tail of reddish-orange flame and appeared to burn out at about 50,000 ft.

**Tactics:** The object was seen directly ahead of the aircraft’s nose and was observed at 45 degrees.

**Note:** Report transmitted through civil aviation channels; the page is a message summary rather than a full narrative report.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 泛美航空 C012 航班机组人员。

**目击：** 1958年9月28日1210Z，飞机在约南纬24度、东经177度附近、飞行高度8500英尺时，机组报告前方出现一团巨大的白光。

**物体：** 该光体朝西南方向飞行，并以约60度角向地表下降。它带有一条很长的红橙色火焰尾迹，看起来在约5万英尺高度熄灭。

**战术：** 目击时该物体正位于机头正前方，观测角约45度。

**注：** 该报告通过民航渠道传递；此页为电报摘要，而非完整叙述。

events.title: Pilot E. Sharman reports doughnut-shaped light over South Brighton
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Canterbury pilot Mr E. Sharman. **Sighting:** He saw an unusual object “last night” while in the South Brighton area. **Object:** It first appeared as a peculiar horseshoe-shaped light in the sky, with ends pointing south, then became a doughnut-shaped object with crinkly edges passing through the horseshoe’s arms; it was seen repeatedly and seemed to be flying round in circles. **Tactics:** The object’s apparent altitude was estimated at 300–500 ft during about half an hour of observation. **Note:** The newspaper item gives no conventional explanation; it is a press report of a concrete local sighting, not a contactee story.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 坎特伯雷飞行员 E. Sharman 先生。**目击经过：** 他在“昨晚”于 South Brighton 一带看见一个异常物体。**物体：** 起初像天空中的一个奇特马蹄形光体，两端朝南；随后又像一个边缘参差、呈甜甜圈状的物体，穿过马蹄形的“臂”之间。该物体被他多次看到，看起来像在绕圈飞行。**动向：** 在约半小时的观察中，他估计其高度约为 300–500 英尺。**说明：** 这则报纸报道没有给出常规解释；它是一起具体的本地目击事件报道，而不是接触者叙述。

events.title: Bright colour-changing object seen over Rotorua
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Janet King of Elizabeth Street, Rotorua, with 11 other people standing in the street. **Sighting:** Between 8:40 and 9:20 pm on Saturday night, they watched a bright object in the southern sky. **Object:** It changed colour from pale lemon through orange to blood red, was said to be about the size of Venus, shone strongly through light cloud, blinked, and seemed to move with each blink while staying within a certain field of the sky. **Tactics:** The object reportedly faded out after its display. **Note:** The clipping says this was apparently the same object also reported from Lake Rotoiti and Whiterock/Whitikau the previous day.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 罗托鲁瓦 Elizabeth Street 的 Janet King，以及当时街上的另外 11 个人。**目击经过：** 周六晚上 8:40 至 9:20 之间，他们看到南方天空中有一个明亮物体。**物体：** 它的颜色从淡柠檬色变为橙色再到血红色，据称大小约与金星相当，在薄云中仍然非常明亮，会闪烁，并且似乎随着每次闪烁而移动，但始终停留在天空中的某一范围内。**行动方式：** 该物体在展示后逐渐消失。**备注：** 报道称，这显然与前一天在 Lake Rotoiti 和 Whiterock/Whitikau 报告的同一物体有关。

events.location: Eglinton Valley near Milford, Southland, NZ
events.title: Flying light near Milford in the Eglinton Valley
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: Eglinton Valley near Milford, Southland, NZ
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Two men travelling on the Milford road in Southland, including Mr E. R. Robinson, an Automobile Association patrol officer, reported the sighting. **Sighting:** On Wednesday night they saw a strange flying light over a lonely stretch of the Eglinton Valley, about 31 miles from the Milford side of The Anau. It appeared at about 11:20 p.m. in dark, cloudy conditions and was watched for 5–8 minutes. **Object:** The light looked like a big, flaming, Tilley-lamp-like object, estimated at about 500 feet high, with no sound and no visible aircraft features. **Tactics:** It moved off at terrific speed, climbed at an angle of about 45 degrees over the hills, then later came back toward them, appeared to stop and hover, and finally moved in two directions at a steep angle. **Note:** The men said it seemed controlled and definitely not ordinary aircraft or weather lights.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 两名男子在南地（Southland）的米尔福德公路上行车时报告了这次目击，其中一人是汽车协会（AA）巡逻员 E. R. Robinson。**目击：** 周三夜里，他们在埃格林顿山谷（Eglinton Valley）一段偏僻路段上方看见一个奇怪的飞行光点，地点约在距 The Anau 米尔福德一侧 31 英里处。事件发生在晚上约 11:20，天气黑暗且多云，他们持续观察了 5–8 分钟。**物体：** 这个光点看上去像一个很大、发亮、带火焰的蒂利灯（Tilley lamp）状物体，估计离地约 500 英尺，没有声音，也看不出普通飞机特征。**动作：** 它以极快速度移动，按约 45 度角越过山丘；后来又朝他们飞来，似乎停住并悬停，最后以很陡的角度向两个方向移动。**注：** 目击者称它像是受控制的，显然不是普通飞机或气象光。

events.location: Wellington Botanical Gardens / Tinakori Hills, Wellington, NZ
events.title: Bright light over Wellington Botanical Gardens and Tinakori Hills
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: Wellington Botanical Gardens / Tinakori Hills, Wellington, NZ
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A civilian servant, reporting by phone. **Sighting:** At about 1620 hrs on Friday 25 July 1957, the witness saw a bright light in the direction of the Wellington Botanical Gardens and Tinakori Hills. **Object:** It moved toward the NW, appeared about the size of a house and then shrank to window-size, remaining visible for 7–8 minutes. It was described as a brilliant light that changed to a bluish-green colour. **Tactics:** No balloons had been released and no aircraft were in the vicinity. **Note:** The reporter suggested it may have been a reflection of sun rays from ice crystals.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一名平民职员，通过电话报告。**目击：** 1957年7月25日星期五约1620时，目击者在惠灵顿植物园和Tinakori山方向看到一束亮光。**物体：** 它向西北方向移动，起初大如一栋房子，随后缩小到窗户大小，持续可见约7–8分钟。描述为一道明亮的光，后来变成蓝绿色。**策略：** 当时没有放飞气球，附近也没有飞机。**备注：** 报告者推测，这可能是冰晶对阳光的反射。

events.date_raw: last night / round about 10 o'clock (newspaper dated 14 Jan 1957)
events.title: Hawke's Bay residents report fast-moving 'flying saucer' lights
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_date: last night / round about 10 o'clock (newspaper dated 14 Jan 1957)
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Several local residents across Hastings, Napier, Havelock North, and Mahora reported the event; one young man said he took a photograph. **Sighting:** The newspaper says an unusual light was seen “last night” and was still being discussed the next morning. **Object:** It was described as a flashing light or “streak” moving rapidly, sometimes westward then reversing, leaving a pencil-like trail and later seeming like a saucer or oval shape. **Tactics:** The light changed direction, moved forward and backward in jerky motions, and at times appeared to disappear in the direction of Cape Kidnappers. **Note:** A footnote suggests at least one report may have been a searchlight from a ship in Napier port, but the clipping presents multiple witness accounts of a concrete sighting.
events.report_summary_zh: **见证人：** 海斯廷斯、纳皮尔、哈维洛克北和马霍拉的多名当地居民报告了该事件；其中一名年轻男子称自己拍了照片。**目击：** 报纸称这一“夜里”的异常景象在次日早晨仍被人们谈论。**物体：** 目击者将其描述为快速移动的闪光或“光带”，有时向西移动后又反向，留下铅笔状尾迹，后来又像碟形或椭圆形。**轨迹：** 该光点会改变方向，前后移动呈跳跃式，有时似乎朝 Cape Kidnappers 方向消失。**注：** 脚注指出其中至少一条报告可能是纳皮尔港船只的探照灯，但这则剪报本身呈现了多名证人的具体目击。

events.location: Channel Island, off Cape Colville, Coromandel coast, NZ
events.title: Smoke-trailing disc seen off Channel Island, Hauraki Gulf
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: Channel Island, off Cape Colville, Coromandel coast, NZ
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A third-class engineer and skipper of the fishing boat *Rosa*, travelling from Tauranga to Auckland, alone on deck. **Sighting:** On 5 May 1957 around 4:30 p.m., near Channel Island off Cape Colville, he saw an irregular smoke trail apparently rising from behind the island, then forming in the sky over the Hauraki Gulf. **Object:** Following the moving smoke, he saw an oval, disc-shaped object with smoke or fumes streaming from it; it travelled horizontally and had curved upper and lower surfaces. **Tactics:** The object appeared to move westward, with the smoke trail twisting erratically across the sky before the source was identified. **Note:** The witness was initially unsure of his eyesight, left the wheel to check the boat, then returned to continue watching; he was alone, so there was no corroborating observer.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 一名持有三类轮机长证照的渔船船长，独自驾驶渔船 *Rosa* 从陶朗加前往奥克兰。**目击：** 1957年5月5日约下午4:30，在科罗曼德尔海岸外、科尔维尔角附近的频道岛一带，他看到一道不规则的烟迹，起初看似从岛后升起，随后在海湾上空形成。**物体：** 顺着烟迹追看后，他看见一个椭圆形、碟状物体，正冒出烟或气体；该物体水平飞行，上下表面都呈弯曲状。**轨迹/动作：** 烟迹在天空中扭曲、方向不定，物体则向西移动。**备注：** 目击者起初怀疑是自己视力出了问题，曾离开舵位检查船上设备；由于当时船上只有他一人，因此没有其他证人。

events.title: Glittering object seen over Temuka garden
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr J. Lane (Maude Street, Temuka) reported the event in a Timaru Herald letter to the editor, saying another adult in his household also watched it. **Sighting:** At about 12:20 p.m. on 1 May 1957, they observed a similar object over the northern end of their property for five or six minutes. **Object:** A small, glittering, spinning object, initially seen over the garden and later over the northern boundary; he described it as a shallow, inverted dinner-plate about 18 in across, moving at high speed and then appearing to vanish without trace. **Tactics:** The witness said the object revolved clockwise, changed position quickly, and on close inspection disappeared completely, leaving no remote control or other obvious indication. **Note:** The clipping also includes an unrelated editorial on “flying saucers.”
events.report_summary_zh: **见证人：**《Timaru Herald》致编辑信中，Temuka 的 Maude Street 居民 J. Lane 报告了此事，并称家中另一位成年人也一起目击。**目击：**1957年5月1日中午约12:20，他们在自家北侧上空看见一个相似物体，持续约五到六分钟。**物体：**一个闪闪发亮、会旋转的小物体，先在花园上方出现，后移至房屋北侧；他形容它像一只浅浅的倒扣盘子，直径约18英寸，速度很快，随后似乎无痕消失。**动作方式：**目击者称其顺时针旋转、迅速移动，并在近距离观察时完全消失，没有明显的遥控或其他迹象。**备注：**该剪报页还包含一篇与此无关的“飞碟”社论。

events.title: Napier night sighting over Westshore Road
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** D. McDonald reported the sighting, with about 20 other people stopping their cars and watching. **Sighting:** On the night of 22 Nov 1955 near Napier, the object was first seen low over the sea between Westshore and Napier, then moved east to west, apparently disappearing behind a bank of cloud and reappearing. **Object:** Described as a bright red/orange light, later much larger than a star, stationary, then rotating and showing a shadow; McDonald thought it may have been a flying object, not a star or recognizable phenomenon. **Tactics:** It stopped, moved slowly, hovered, and seemed to brighten as cars stopped to watch. **Note:** This is a press/newsletter-style report in a C.S.I. compilation, not an official RNZAF investigation.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** D. McDonald 进行了报告，另外还有大约 20 名在堤岸公路上停车观看的人。**目击情况：** 1955 年 11 月 22 日夜间，纳皮尔附近海面上方先看到一个物体，随后从 Westshore 与 Napier 之间低空出现，再向东到西移动，似乎一度消失在云后又重新出现。**物体：** 被描述为一个明亮的红橙色光点，后来看起来比一颗星还大；它曾保持静止、随后旋转，并显出一个阴影；McDonald 认为那像是某种飞行物，而不像星星或可识别现象。**战术：** 物体会停住、缓慢移动、悬停；当车辆停下观察时，它似乎变得更亮。**注：** 这是 C.S.I. 汇编中的报刊/通讯式报道，不是 RNZAF 官方调查记录。

events.title: Lights over Blind Channel, Tasman Bay
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr. and Mrs. I. M. Bethwaite, leaving Nelson Airport after dark. **Sighting:** At about 8:15 p.m. they stopped to watch a peculiar phenomenon and then saw a bright yellow light appear in the sky near the north-western boundary of the Blind Channel, at little more than a mile distance. **Object:** The light moved downward in a curve toward the water, then another light appeared; two more lights followed, blinking off and on, moving at times in apparent unison. They were later joined by a central light and all lights were observed to form a pattern that appeared to move along or just above the water. **Tactics:** The lights kept blinking and changing position, briefly creating the impression of a “met” control tower nearby; the observers noted it was difficult to judge distance or size and at one point the display seemed to shift behind a cloud or darker area. **Note:** The article is a press-style UFO report from Nelson/Tasman Bay and gives a concrete date, place, witnesses, and sequence of observations.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Nelson 的 I. M. Bethwaite 夫妇，在天黑后离开 Nelson 机场时目击。**目击经过：** 大约晚上 8:15，他们停下来观看一种奇怪现象，随后看见一团明亮的黄色光出现在天空中，位置接近 Blind Channel 的西北边界，距离约一英里多一点。**物体：** 该光点先以弧线向下移动接近水面，随后又出现另一团光；之后再出现两团光，忽明忽灭，移动时似乎彼此同步。后来又出现一个中心光点，所有光点似乎组成一个图样，沿着或几乎贴着水面移动。**战术：** 这些光点持续闪烁并改变位置，短暂地让人以为附近有一个“控制塔”；目击者表示很难判断距离或大小，并且在某一时刻，这一景象似乎移到了云层或较暗区域后方。**备注：** 这是一则关于 Nelson/Tasman Bay 的报刊式 UFO 报道，包含明确日期、地点、目击者与观察过程。

events.title: Red ball in sky seen by Balclutha truck driver
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr Jim Beeby of Balclutha, seated in his truck on Paisley Street. **Sighting:** On Friday night he noticed a bright red light in the sky “looking like the rear red reflector light of a modern car” seen through mist. It was first spotted around 8:00 p.m. and later reappeared about an hour later. **Object:** A red, glowing light; at first thought to be a reflection, then possibly a “flying saucer,” though the witness said it was a very unusual sight. **Tactics:** The light appeared briefly, disappeared, then returned; it was viewed for roughly 30 seconds on the first observation and again for about 15 seconds later. **Note:** This page is a newspaper clipping page with multiple unrelated UFO reports; this is one concrete sighting reported by the *Clutha Leader*.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 巴尔克卢萨（Balclutha）当地人 Jim Beeby，当时坐在 Paisley Street 的卡车里。**目击：** 周五晚上，他看到天空中有一道明亮的红光，形状“像现代汽车尾灯”，并且是在雾中看到的。第一次大约在晚上 8:00 被发现，约一小时后又再次出现。**物体：** 一个发红发亮的光点；起初以为是反光，后来又被认为可能是“飞碟”，但目击者说这是一种非常不寻常的景象。**轨迹/行为：** 光点短暂出现后消失，随后再度出现；第一次约持续 30 秒，第二次约 15 秒。**注：** 这一页是报纸剪报页，包含多则不同的 UFO 报道；这里选取的是《Clutha Leader》报道的这一则具体目击事件。

events.title: Blenheim daylight object tracked by theodolite
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A Riverton resident also appears in the clipping, but the concrete investigated event is the Woodbourne/Blenheim daylight observation by engineer M. J. Clark, with later analysis from H. H. Fulton and RNZAF staff. **Sighting:** On 26 July 1956, Clark watched an object in the northwest sky at about 10:15 a.m. and tracked it with a 20-power theodolite. He recorded its altitude, azimuth, and movement while it appeared to hover, rise, and then fade in stronger sunlight. **Object:** Initially described as an unidentified object with a bright/white appearance; the report later argues the observations match Venus. **Tactics:** Clark noted the object’s apparent motion relative to the sun, clouds, and horizon, and made timed instrument readings. **Note:** This page is a newspaper clipping containing both the sighting report and the follow-up astronomical explanation.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 剪报中也提到一名 Riverton 居民，但这里具体被调查的事件是 Woodbourne/Blenheim 的日间观测，观察者为工程师 M. J. Clark，后续分析由 H. H. Fulton 和 RNZAF 人员参与。**目击：** 1956 年 7 月 26 日上午约 10:15，Clark 看到西北方天空中的一个物体，并用 20 倍经纬仪进行追踪。他记录了其高度、方位和移动情况；该物体似乎曾悬停、上升，随后在更强的阳光下变淡。**物体：** 起初被描述为不明物体，外观明亮/偏白；报告后文认为这些观测与金星相符。**手法：** Clark 结合太阳、云层与地平线的位置，进行了定时的仪器读数。**备注：** 这一页是报纸剪报，同时包含目击报告和后续的天文解释。

events.title: Orange light over Wairau Road, Marlborough
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr. N. C. Daken first saw the object and called his wife; he then alerted Mr. T. MacDonald and the two wives, with later corroboration from nearby observers. **Sighting:** On 26 July 1956 the group watched a light in the sky for about 10 minutes before it gradually faded from view. **Object:** It appeared round and orange with a bright leading edge and green tail, later developing a bright white upper edge; witnesses also reported a glow in the sky and a later “flare drop.” **Tactics:** The light moved slowly at first, then seemed to accelerate and climb to about 45 degrees above the horizon, with an impression of changing brightness and shape. **Note:** The page is a CSI newsletter account based on witness statements and follow-up questions about the observers’ experience, not a formal military report.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** N. C. Daken 先生先看到该物体并叫来妻子，随后通知了 T. MacDonald 先生，两位妻子也一起观看，后来附近还有其他人作了侧面印证。**目击经过：** 1956年7月26日，这群人观察天空中的光点约10分钟，之后它逐渐消失。**物体：** 起初看起来是圆形橙色亮点，前缘发亮、拖着绿色尾迹；后来上缘又显出明亮的白色光边。目击者还提到天空中有光辉，并看到一次类似“火焰/亮点脱落”的现象。**动作/轨迹：** 该光点先是缓慢移动，随后似乎加速并爬升到距地平线约45度的位置，同时亮度和形状也在变化。**注：** 这页是 CSI（民间飞碟调查）通讯中的目击描述，基于目击者陈述和后续询问，而非正式军方报告。

events.title: Unusual glowing object seen near Taumarunui
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A farmer near Taumarunui reported the object first, and the page also includes a related witness letter from R. A. Ferri in Hamilton describing a separate but similar observation. **Sighting:** On 7 August 1956 an unusual object was seen in the sky near Taumarunui and observed for several minutes. **Object:** It was described as star-like at first, then as a perfectly round, bright glowing object, later looking like a disc or sphere with a surrounding glow. **Tactics:** It moved slowly, then upward and southward, sometimes seeming to stop and then change direction; it finally disappeared behind clouds over Hospital Hill. **Note:** This page is a press-clipping compilation of multiple sightings; the Taumarunui report is the most concrete single event on the page.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 这页提到一名在陶马鲁努伊（Taumarunui）附近的农夫最先报告了该物体，另有汉密尔顿的 R. A. Ferri 写来的相关目击信。**目击：** 1956年8月7日，陶马鲁努伊附近天空出现一个不寻常物体，并被观察了几分钟。**物体：** 起初像一颗星，随后被描述为一个完全圆形、明亮发光的物体，后来像一个带有光晕的圆盘或球体。**动作：** 它先缓慢移动，之后向上并向南移动，有时似乎停住又改变方向，最终在医院山（Hospital Hill）上方的云层后消失。**备注：** 这页是多条新闻剪报的汇编；其中陶马鲁努伊报道是页面上最具体的单一事件。

events.title: New Plymouth hovering object near Port Taranaki
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** A resident in the Port Taranaki area near New Plymouth, with corroboration from nearby Paritutu Road residents. **Sighting:** On the evening of 11 Aug 1956, the witness saw an object in the heavens for several minutes before it was obscured by cloud. **Object:** It appeared as a spinning, hovering object, sometimes leaving a trail of haze; it was described as a golden glow and later as resembling a dinner plate, round, with top and bottom domes. **Tactics:** It was first noticed at a distance, stayed nearly stationary while seeming to move/turn, then became hidden by cloud. **Note:** The clipping is a press report on a concrete local sighting, not a contactee narrative.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 新普利茅斯（Port Taranaki 一带）的一名居民，附近 Paritutu Road 的居民也有观察到。**目击：** 1956年8月11日晚，目击者看到天空中的一个物体持续了几分钟，随后被云层遮住。**物体：** 它看起来像一个旋转、悬停的物体，有时拖着一条雾状尾迹；报道中称其为金色光团，后来又像一个盘子，呈圆形，上下都有凸起。**动向：** 该物体最初在远处被注意到，几乎保持不动，同时似乎在转动或移动，之后被云遮挡。**注：** 这是一则关于具体本地目击事件的报纸报道，不是“接触者”叙述。

events.title: Shiny silver object seen over New Plymouth
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr. A. Woodhouse, a resident of New Plymouth. **Sighting:** Early on Saturday morning, he was awakened by a bright light and saw an object flying over the centre of New Plymouth. **Object:** He described it as a shiny silver object about three-quarters its length, with a slight rise in the centre giving it a saucer-like shape and a reflection; after passing over the city it headed north-west and was hidden by cloud. **Tactics:** It moved over the city at low altitude, then continued north-west out over the coast. **Note:** The article states no scheduled aircraft were flying over the city at the time.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 新普利茅斯居民 A. Woodhouse。**目击：** 星期六清晨，他被一道亮光惊醒，看见一个物体飞过新普利茅斯市中心上空。**物体：** 他描述其为银色发亮的物体，长度约为其三分之四，中部略微隆起，呈碟状并有反光；飞越市区后它转向西北，随后被云层遮住。**轨迹/动作：** 该物体以较低高度越过市区，然后继续向西北飞向海岸外。**注：** 文中称当时市区上空并无预定航班飞行。

events.title: Swift cigar-shaped object sighted over Auckland
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Multiple independent observers around Auckland, including pilots, airport staff, and local residents; named witnesses include Capt. H. Hill and Mr. G. Warner. **Sighting:** On the evening of 3 Sept 1956, a fast-moving object was reported over Auckland and Whenuapai, with later corroborating reports from Milford, Takapuna, and nearby areas. **Object:** Described as a flying cigar-shaped or ball-point-pen-like object, sometimes appearing as a cluster of bluish lights, moving at high speed on a flat trajectory. **Tactics:** Witnesses said it changed shape/appearance, seemed to bank or turn, and vanished abruptly after a few seconds. **Note:** This page is a press-style compilation of several related reports, but the Auckland cigar-shaped object report is concrete and dated.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 奥克兰周边的多名独立目击者，包括飞行员、机场工作人员和当地居民；点名者有 H. Hill 上尉与 G. Warner 先生。**目击：** 1956年9月3日晚，奥克兰与 Whenuapai 上空有人报告看到一个高速移动物体，后续在 Milford、Takapuna 等地也出现了相互印证的报告。**物体：** 被描述为飞行的雪茄状或圆珠笔状物体，有时像一团蓝色光点，以很高速度沿平直轨迹移动。**动作：** 目击者称它会改变外形/外观，似乎会转弯或倾斜，并在数秒后突然消失。**备注：** 这一页是新闻剪报式的多则汇编，但其中关于奥克兰雪茄状物体的报道具有明确日期与地点。

events.title: Bert Thomson's white 'cigarette' sighting near New Plymouth
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr. Bert Thomson, a Kaponga resident, as reported in *The Auckland Star* via a New Plymouth press clipping. **Sighting:** He said he saw an object “yesterday morning,” near the Hawera–Eltham area, flying at about 1,500 feet in an easterly direction. **Object:** He described it as a “perfectly good eyes”/cigarette-shaped craft about 70 feet long and 30 feet wide, moving very fast, with a hissing sound that increased and a white light followed by a blue one. **Tactics:** The object maintained speed and altitude while passing overhead; the clipping notes no attempt at interaction. **Note:** This page is a Civilian Saucer Investigation newsletter excerpt citing a newspaper report of a concrete local sighting.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Kaponga 居民 Bert Thomson，据《The Auckland Star》转引的新普利茅斯报导。**目击经过：** 他称自己在“昨天早上”于 Hawera—Eltham 一带看到一个物体，约在 1,500 英尺高度，朝东方飞行。**物体：** 他形容其像一支“雪茄”形飞行器，约长 70 英尺、宽 30 英尺，速度很快，并伴随逐渐增强的嘶嘶声，尾部有白光，随后出现蓝光。**战术：** 该物体保持速度与高度通过上空，报道中未提到任何互动。**备注：** 本页是 Civilian Saucer Investigation 资讯页，引用了报纸对一则具体地方目击事件的报道。

events.title: Daylight disc seen over McKinney, Texas
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Roy Hall, the local weather observer in McKinney, reported the encounter, with additional corroboration from people in town and linemen on telephone poles. **Sighting:** On a clear afternoon he noticed a weather-balloon-like object in the western sky, then saw it again later near town as a second dark object. **Object:** Described as round or balloon-like, later appearing as a dark, dull-white body at about 11,000 ft, then roughly 100,000 ft away, and finally a 220-ft-high, teardrop-shaped object with a diameter of about 50 ft. **Tactics:** It seemed to maneuver against the wind, move in jumps, change position without visible rotation, and depart to the southwest. **Note:** The article presents the account as a notable sighting, but it is a press clipping rather than an official NZ report.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 麦金尼（McKinney）的当地气象观测员 Roy Hall 报告了这次经历，镇上其他人以及电话线杆上的工人也提供了旁证。**目击：** 在一个晴朗的下午，他先在西方天空看到一个像气象气球的物体，之后又在镇附近再次看见一个第二个黑色物体。**物体：** 其外观被描述为圆形或像气球，后来像一个暗淡的白色物体，约在 11,000 英尺高度；随后又被估计在约 100,000 英尺远处；最后变成一个高度约 220 英尺、泪滴状、直径约 50 英尺的物体。**动作：** 它似乎逆风机动、跳跃式移动、在不见明显旋转的情况下改变位置，并向西南方向离开。**备注：** 这是一则报纸剪报中的目击叙述，而非新西兰官方报告。

events.title: Belfast man reports landing saucer that escaped near police station
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr. Thomas Hutchinson of The Loup, near Londonderry, said he and his wife saw the object while driving, and police later followed up the report. **Sighting:** On Friday night near Belfast/Londonderry, he claimed a saucer landed on a farm track, then he approached it cautiously. **Object:** Egg-shaped and pointed at both ends, about three feet high and eighteen inches in diameter at the widest point, coloured bright red with two dark red stripes; it glowed and seemed to hover. **Tactics:** Hutchinson said he touched it, it turned over, and as he tried to carry it to the police station it slipped from his grasp, spun, and disappeared from sight in a flash of red. **Note:** The article also says the Royal Air Force station at Aldergrove found no aircraft in the area at the time.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** The Loup 附近的 Thomas Hutchinson 先生说，他和妻子在驾车时看见了该物体，之后警方也对这起报告进行了调查。**目击：** 1956年9月10日星期五晚间，靠近贝尔法斯特/伦敦德里时，他声称一个“飞碟”降落在一条农场小路上，随后他小心接近。**物体：** 呈蛋形、两端尖，约3英尺高，最宽处直径约18英寸，亮红色并带两条深红色条纹；它会发光，看起来像是悬停着。**过程：** Hutchinson 说他碰了一下它，它翻转过来；当他试图把它带到警察局时，它从手中滑脱、旋转并在一道红光中消失。**备注：** 文章还提到，Aldergrove 的皇家空军基地表示当时附近没有飞机活动。

events.title: Perego reports fleet of flying saucers over Rome
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Vice-consul Dr. Alberto Perego. **Sighting:** He reported that on 6 Nov 1955, between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m., he observed a fleet of about 100 flying saucers over Rome. **Object:** The objects were described as flying saucers, moving at an estimated 10–12 km altitude and 1,200–1,400 km/h. **Tactics:** Perego said the formation was seen over Rome and was later discussed in a press/clipping context, with mention that further details were expected for 1956. **Note:** The page is mostly a Civilian Saucer Investigation NZ balance sheet/editorial page, but the clipping at the top contains a concrete sighting report.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 代领事阿尔贝托·佩雷戈博士。**目击：** 他报告称，1955年11月6日上午11点到下午1点之间，他在罗马上空看见了一群约100个“飞碟”。**物体：** 这些物体被描述为飞碟，估计高度为10–12公里，速度为1,200–1,400公里/小时。**战术：** 佩雷戈称该编队出现在罗马上空，后续还在新闻剪辑语境中被讨论，并提到1956年会有更多细节。**注：** 该页主体是新西兰民间飞碟研究会的收支平衡表/社论内容，但页顶的剪报包含了一则具体的目击报告。

events.title: Hatuma farmer reports bright beam of light in bedroom
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_date: last Tuesday morning at about 2.10 a.m.
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr W. R. Kibblewhite, a farmer at Hatuma in Hawke’s Bay, reported the incident. **Sighting:** He awoke with cramp at about 2:10 a.m., was walking back to bed, and saw a bright beam of light shining in from the open window and reflecting in a mirror. **Object:** The beam was described as a tiny point only three inches across at the window, but widening to about 12–18 inches inside the room; it flashed blue, then white, and gave him a strong sensation as if being photographed. **Tactics:** The beam switched off abruptly when he turned a torch toward it, and reappeared briefly after he moved out of the room. **Note:** This is a newspaper clipping about a local unusual-light report rather than an official investigation record.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Hatuma 的农夫 W. R. Kibblewhite 报告了这起事件。**目击经过：** 他在凌晨约 2:10 因腿抽筋醒来，正走回床边时，看见一束明亮的光从敞开的窗户照入，并在镜子里反射。**物体：** 这束光在窗外看起来只有约三英寸宽，但进入房间后扩展到约 12–18 英寸；它先闪蓝光、后转白光，并让他产生一种像被拍照一样的强烈感觉。**行动方式：** 当他用手电筒照向那道光时，它突然熄灭；他离开房间后又短暂出现。**备注：** 这是一则关于当地异常光现象的报纸剪报，不是官方调查记录。

events.title: Hatuma farmer sees bright beam and flash near window
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr W. R. Kibblewhite, a farmer near Hatuma in Hawke's Bay. **Sighting:** About 2:10 a.m. on Tuesday, he awoke with cramp, got up to exercise his leg, and while walking back toward bed saw a bright beam of light shining in and reflecting in a mirror. **Object:** The beam was described as narrow at first (about 3 inches across), then turning abruptly into a larger blue flash roughly 12 to 18 inches across. It lasted only a few seconds; he felt a strong sensation as if being stared at, but the beam did not illuminate the whole room and looked unlike an ordinary searchlight. **Tactics:** The light seemed to switch on and off abruptly and appeared to come from outside the open window area. **Note:** This is a newspaper account of a concrete local incident rather than editorial comment; the report was published on 4 Dec 1956, but the sighting itself occurred the previous Tuesday morning.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 海湾区 Hatuma 附近的一位农民 W. R. Kibblewhite 先生。**目击经过：** 大约凌晨 2:10，他因腿抽筋醒来，起身活动时，看见一道明亮的光束照进室内，并在镜子中反射出来。**物体：** 这道光起初很窄（约 3 英寸宽），随后突然变成更大的蓝色闪光，宽约 12 到 18 英寸。整个过程只持续了几秒钟；他还强烈感觉像是被什么东西注视着，但光束并未照亮整间房，也不像普通探照灯。**行为特征：** 这道光似乎是从窗外突然开关般出现和消失的。**备注：** 这是一则关于具体地方事件的报纸报道，而非社论；报纸刊于 1956 年 12 月 4 日，但目击发生在前一个星期二凌晨。

events.title: Mrs McEwen reports bright objects over Rissington
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mrs D. McEwen of Rissington, with her husband Mr McEwen mentioned in the article. **Sighting:** She reported seeing unidentified lights/objects over Rissington on New Year’s Day and again “last night,” with the newspaper clipping focusing on her account of the event. **Object:** The first object was described as long, bright, and newspaper-shaped with rays extending from it; later objects were different, twinkling golden and surrounded by spectral-coloured rays, moving very slowly. **Tactics:** The lights were seen in a north-easterly direction and appeared to remain in roughly the same position. **Note:** This is a press clipping describing a concrete local sighting, not a contactee narrative.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Rissington 的 D. McEwen 夫人，文中也提到她的丈夫 Mr McEwen。**目击：** 她报告在元旦当天以及“昨晚”在 Rissington 上空看到不明灯光/物体；这份报纸剪报主要转述她的经历。**物体：** 第一个物体被描述为细长、明亮、像一张报纸，并向外发出光芒；后来的物体则不同，呈闪烁的金黄色，周围有光谱般的光线，移动非常缓慢。**动作/行为：** 这些灯光出现在东北方向，看起来大致停留在相近位置。**注：** 这是报道当地具体目击事件的报纸剪报，不是接触者故事。

events.title: Bright "flying newspaper" seen over Rissington, Hawke's Bay
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr and Mrs D. McEwen of Rissington, Hawke's Bay. **Sighting:** The article says they first noticed the object on New Year's Day, then saw it again the next night. **Object:** A bright, gold-coloured light with coloured rays, described as a “mystery light” or “flying newspaper,” seeming flat and newspaper-shaped at first, then later appearing as a smaller round light. **Tactics:** It hovered above Rissington, moved off rapidly toward the north-east, and on the later sighting took about 15 minutes to go out of sight while moving very slowly before departing. **Note:** This is a newspaper report about a concrete local sighting, not contactee material.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 霍克斯湾 Rissington 的 D. McEwen 先生和夫人，丈夫是牧羊人。**目击情况：** 文章称他们先在元旦看见该物体，随后在第二天夜里又看见一次。**物体：** 一个明亮的金色光体，带有彩色光芒；起初像“报纸”一样扁平，后来又像一个较小的圆形光点。**行动：** 它在 Rissington 上方盘旋，随后迅速朝东北方向离去；后一次目击中，它先缓慢移动，再用约 15 分钟消失在视野中。**说明：** 这是关于一次具体本地目击的报纸报道，不是接触者叙述。

events.title: Balfour men report a changing flying-saucer-like light
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** William West and Wallace Liddell, local men from Balfour. **Sighting:** In the early hours of Saturday morning, while standing in the doorway of a garage on West’s property about two miles from Balfour, they saw a bright object approaching from the direction of some trees. **Object:** Described first like a shooting star, then as a glowing object that continued to fall, looked like a saucer or bright light, and later appeared to change shape. **Tactics:** The object moved across the sky, then seemed to hover or slow before fading/disappearing from view. **Note:** This page is a newspaper clipping about the sighting, not the original report.
events.report_summary_zh: **见证人：** 巴尔福（Balfour）的两名当地男子威廉·韦斯特（William West）和华莱士·利德尔（Wallace Liddell）。**目击：** 在星期六凌晨，两人站在韦斯特农场上一座车库门口（距巴尔福约两英里），看到一个明亮物体从树木方向接近。**物体：** 起初像一颗流星，随后像一个发光物体继续下降，看起来像飞碟或亮光，并且后来似乎改变了形状。**行为：** 该物体在天空中移动，随后似乎悬停或减速，最后逐渐消失。**注：** 这一页是报道该事件的报纸剪报，不是原始报告。

events.title: Rotorua night sky object seen moving north to south
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Rotorua residents including Mrs Dorothy Bell, her husband Doug, announcer Lindsay Bioberg, and Penny Bell. **Sighting:** They reported seeing an unidentified object in the eastern sky on the evening of 3 Apr 1957, around 6:40 p.m., moving from north to south. **Object:** Described as a bright bluish/greenish light; one account likened it to a small object or 'little green man' inside a bright light, with no clear structure seen. **Tactics:** The object reportedly traversed the sky quickly and silently, leaving observers confused; there were no reported sound effects or obvious aircraft features. **Note:** This is a newspaper clipping summarizing a local sighting, not a filing memo; the report also references earlier Rotorua-area UFO stories.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Rotorua 的居民，包括 Dorothy Bell 夫人、她的丈夫 Doug Bell、播音员 Lindsay Bioberg，以及 9 岁的 Penny Bell。**目击经过：** 他们报告称在 1957 年 4 月 3 日傍晚约 6:40，于东侧天空看到一个不明物体，由北向南移动。**物体：** 被描述为一团明亮的蓝绿色光；其中一则说法把它比作亮光中有个“小绿人”，但未看清具体结构。**动作/行为：** 该物体据称快速、无声地穿过天空，使目击者困惑；未报告有发动机声或明显飞机特征。**注：** 这是一则报纸剪报，转述当地目击事件，并非文件备忘录；文中还提到 Rotorua 地区更早的 UFO 传闻。

events.title: Taradale schoolchildren report silvery object over Redcliffe hills
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_date: yesterday during morning break at 10 a.m. (clipping dated 18/4/57)
events.report_summary: **Witness:** About 30 children at a Taradale playground, with additional reports from Bay View and suburban Napier. **Sighting:** During morning break at about 10 a.m., the children saw a flying object pass over the area. **Object:** It was described as a long, silvery object with no cabin, wings, or tailpiece; it glided horizontally over Redcliffe hills, then turned upward and disappeared behind clouds. **Tactics:** No sound was heard and the object was said to move smoothly before climbing away. **Note:** The clipping also mentions other “unusual occurrences” in the air, but this page is specifically about the Taradale sighting.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 约30名塔拉代尔（Taradale）学校操场上的儿童，另有来自Bay View和内皮尔郊区的目击报告。**目击：** 在上午休息时间约10点，孩子们看到一个飞行物从该地区上空掠过。**物体：** 据描述为一个细长、银色的物体，没有机舱、机翼或尾部；它平稳地水平掠过Redcliffe hills，随后上升并消失在云后。**方式：** 据称没有听到任何声音，物体先平滑移动，随后爬升离去。**备注：** 这张剪报还提到其他“空中异常现象”，但本页具体讲的是塔拉代尔这次目击。

events.title: Bright object over Ngaruawahia, described as a 'tennis ball' in the sky
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Mr Frank P. Duggan and his wife, Ngaruawahia café proprietors, reported the event after seeing it from their home. **Sighting:** Around 4:40 a.m., Duggan woke to a bright light through the bedroom window and watched it for about a quarter of an hour before it moved off; his wife also observed it. **Object:** He described a very bright, stationary object in the western sky, “similar to a saucer on edge” and later like “a tennis ball,” with an orange-coloured disc and a size resembling a bread-and-butter plate at arm’s length. **Tactics:** It appeared to bob, drop swiftly, rise again several times, then move away and disappear from view. **Note:** This is a press clipping reporting a concrete local sighting, not a contactee narrative.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** Ngaruawahia 的咖啡店老板 Frank P. Duggan 及其妻子从家中看到这一事件。**目击：** 大约清晨 4:40，Duggan 被卧室窗外透入的强光惊醒，观察了约十五分钟后该物体才移动；他的妻子也看到了它。**物体：** 他形容西方天空中有一个非常明亮、静止的物体，“像竖着的飞碟”，后来又像“一只网球”，呈橙色圆盘状，大小看起来像伸直手臂时的一块黄油面包盘。**动作：** 它似乎上下弹动，迅速下沉又再次升起，如此反复数次，然后离开并消失。**注：** 这是一则报道具体本地目击事件的报纸剪报，不是接触者叙事。

events.title: Bright metallic object over Wellington
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Report from the Wellington Air Traffic Centre, describing an observer watching the sky over Wellington. **Sighting:** At 15:45 on 29 Nov 1956, a bright object was seen gliding in the sunshine above Wellington. **Object:** It appeared metallic, came from the south, then hovered for about 10–15 minutes. **Tactics:** The object then moved east, climbed very rapidly, and disappeared from view. **Note:** The report records a clear date, location, witness source, and a concrete observation, but gives no size, altitude, or identification.
events.report_summary_zh: **目击者：** 来自惠灵顿空中交通中心的报告，描述一名观察者在惠灵顿上空看到天空中的物体。**目击：** 1956年11月29日15:45，一个明亮的物体被看到在惠灵顿上空于阳光中滑行。**物体：** 它看起来是金属质地，从南方接近，随后悬停了约10至15分钟。**动作：** 之后该物体向东移动，迅速爬升，并从视野中消失。**注：** 该报告包含明确的日期、地点、目击来源和具体观测，但没有给出尺寸、高度或确认身份。

events.title: Bright stationary object seen from Harvard over Wigram
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary: **Witness:** Flying Officer R.A. Currin, flying in a Harvard with Sqn Ldr Roe. **Sighting:** At about 1000 hours on 10 Aug 1956, during a flight from Wigram, Currin noticed a very bright patch in the sky to the north. He called Roe’s attention to it, and both observed it. **Object:** Initially appeared round, very bright, apparently stationary, and estimated to be at least 70 nautical miles away at about 20,000 feet; when seen again later it appeared larger and more elliptical. **Tactics:** The object was first seen while the aircraft was flying an exercise circuit, then seen again on rejoining the circuit before landing. **Note:** The witness did not suggest what the object might have been.
